messages:
Sam (Support): FYI customer AcroSupply's AP system keeps rejecting our invoices. They say required header fields missing: 'LegalCompanyName', 'RegisteredAddress', 'VAT Number'. Also their AP requires each line item to list VatRate and TaxableAmount. Our PDF renders shortname only and global VAT total — their system fails the lineitem validation. Ticket #12345. Repro steps below.

Maya (Finance): Thanks — can you paste the invoice id and the raw invoice JSON payload we send to the renderer? Also which template (eu/default) are we using for this account?

Sam (Support): Invoice id: inv_2026_07_3199. Payload we send (trimmed):
```json
{
  "id": "inv_2026_07_3199",
  "customer": {
    "short_name": "AcroSupply",
    "billing_contact": "ap@acrosupply.com"
  },
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "Service A", "qty": 1, "unit_price": 100.00, "tax": 20.00},
    {"desc": "Service B", "qty": 2, "unit_price": 50.00, "tax": 10.00}
  ],
  "total_vat": 30.00
}
```
No legal_entity block present in this payload. We render on hosted API: GET /v1/invoices/inv_2026_07_3199/pdf returns a 200 and the PDF attachment. Customer attached their AP rejection: "missing VAT number in header" and "line items missing VatRate/TaxableAmount".

Jamal (Eng): Looks like the billing service is using the generic 'default' template which flattens tax into total_vat. For EU B2B we have an alternate renderer that expects a 'legal_entity' object under account with fields: full_name, registered_address, vat_number, and line items with vat_rate / taxable_amount. Can you confirm account settings for AcroSupply?

Eli (Billing): I checked the account metadata — they signed up via self-serve and only provided company short_name. No legal_entity info on file. The region is EU.

Maya (Finance): Customer says they attached a PO and their AP system will only accept PDFs that include the company's registered legal name + VAT number in header and each line item with rate. Can we re-render and push corrected PDFs so their AP can process past invoices?

Jamal (Eng): Short-term workaround: we can re-render that invoice with the eu_b2b template if we populate a minimal legal_entity on the account. Patch plan: 1) Add fields to account metadata for their legal entity (we ask customer to confirm exact registered name + VAT). 2) Re-render invoice(s) using eu_b2b template. 3) Re-upload PDFs to the portal and send new attachments. I can push a hotfix to the renderer to prefer eu_b2b when region=EU and vat present. Estimated: patch to renderer today (EOD), backfill job to re-render last 30 days tomorrow.

Sam (Support): Customer provided legal_entity details in the thread: 
- LegalCompanyName: Acro Supplies Ltd.
- RegisteredAddress: 12 Harbor Way, Dublin, IE
- VAT Number: IE1234567V
They need the re-render before COB tomorrow.

InvoiceBot: render-service: queued job render:inv_2026_07_3199 with template=default (started at 1915001300)

Jamal (Eng): I can change the queue job to re-run with template=eu_b2b for that invoice. Command I will run: 
```bash
# re-render single invoice
POST /internal/render/requeue
{ "invoice_id": "inv_2026_07_3199", "template": "eu_b2b" }
```
This will produce PDF with header: legal_entity.full_name, legal_entity.vat_number and line item table with VatRate and TaxableAmount columns.

Maya (Finance): If we re-render, can we also stamp the PDF metadata with the PO number and remittance instructions? Their AP requires PO in header.

Jamal (Eng): Yes — renderer supports adding optional fields from invoice.custom_fields. We can set custom_fields.po_number and remittance_address. I'll coordinate with Billing to update payload before re-render.

Eli (Billing): I'll update the account metadata and the invoice custom_fields now. Once done, tag @Jamal and I'll trigger the re-render.

Sam (Support): Customer confirmed PO: PO-778899. Please include it and let me know once new PDF posted so I can send it back to them.

Jamal (Eng): Plan: 1) Billing will add legal_entity + custom_fields (in 30m). 2) I will requeue render with eu_b2b (in 45m). 3) Re-upload and notify support (in 1.5h). If anything blocks, I will post here.

Maya (Finance): Can we also get a checklist to avoid this recurring? E.g., account onboarding validation that requires legal_entity fields for EU customers with VAT.

Jamal (Eng): Agreed — I'll file a short RFC for onboarding validation and a small QA test for invoice templates. I'll include a schema check in the billing pipeline.

Sam (Support): Awesome, thanks team. Marking high priority. :white_check_mark:
